# Constants

Global constants available to every Ethos Lua script. Use them by name, e.g. `lcd.font(FONT_L)` or `system.getSource({category=CATEGORY_TELEMETRY_SENSOR, ...})`.

## Fonts

Used with `lcd.font()`.

| Constant | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| <span id="font-m"></span>`FONT_M` | M Font |
| <span id="font-m-bold"></span>`FONT_M_BOLD` | M BOLD Font |
| <span id="font-m-italic"></span>`FONT_M_ITALIC` | M ITALIC Font |
| <span id="font-xs"></span>`FONT_XS` | XS Font |
| <span id="font-xxs"></span>`FONT_XXS` | XXS Font |
| <span id="font-xs-bold"></span>`FONT_XS_BOLD` | XS BOLD Font (not available on X18 and Horus) |
| <span id="font-l-bold"></span>`FONT_L_BOLD` | L BOLD Font (not available on X18 and Horus) |
| <span id="font-s-bold"></span>`FONT_S_BOLD` | S BOLD Font (not available on X18 and Horus) |
| <span id="font-s"></span>`FONT_S` | S Font |
| <span id="font-l"></span>`FONT_L` | L Font |
| <span id="font-xl"></span>`FONT_XL` | XL Font |
| <span id="font-xxl"></span>`FONT_XXL` | XXL Font |
